message.content: {"appearance_facts": [{"location": "Georgia (GA)", "fact": "The state polygon is filled with a very dark, deep maroon color."}, {"location": "Rhode Island (RI)", "fact": "The state polygon is filled with a medium-dark red color, which is visibly lighter than the fill of Georgia."}, {"location": "Delaware (DE)", "fact": "The state polygon is filled with a light orange/peach color, indicating a lower value on the scale."}, {"location": "Color scale", "fact": "The vertical legend on the right shows a gradient from light yellow at the top (labeled 'High') to dark maroon at the bottom (labeled 'Low')."}, {"location": "Comparison", "fact": "The dark maroon fill of Georgia matches the 'Low' end of the color scale, while the red fill of Rhode Island corresponds to a higher position on the scale."}], "printed_facts": [{"location": "Top left", "fact": "Title reads 'Prevalence of Species Z in US States'."}, {"location": "Right side", "fact": "Legend title is 'High' at the top and 'Low' at the bottom."}, {"location": "Right side", "fact": "Numeric axis ranges from 100 at the top to 0 at the bottom."}, {"location": "Map", "fact": "State abbreviations are printed within their respective borders."}], "public_definitions": [], "uncertain": []}
